title: CLI tests: the binary run over a generated journal
objective: Tests under `tests/` that run the cldr binary over a generated journal, beside the unit tests, as TN0002's Open section asks: `render` run twice changes nothing and leaves the text outside the markers intact, `briefing`, `month new` on a scratch tree, and `export`'s refusal without `--force`. All data is synthetic (`@acme`, `example.com`). devbin's `check autotests` fails a second auto-discovered target, so the crate sets `autotests = false` and declares `packaging` and `cli` by name.
